title: Score Interpretation
description: A standardized interpretation of a set of topic scores, typically one of several in a score interpretation list.

id.description: Unique identifier for this score interpretation. Kebab case. Ex: 'my-interpretation-id'

name.description: A friendly name used for display

description.description: A brief explanation of this score interpretation

requirements.description: A logical expression of topics and required scores for this interpretation. Supports logical operators (and, or) for composing requirements. A flat topic-score map is treated as implicit 'and'. Operators may have a unique identifier suffix (e.g., 'and-12345', 'or-1'). Topic keys always contain a dot (dependency.topic) so they cannot conflict with operator keywords.

^and(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: All expressions must be satisfied. Each entry in the value is a separate operand.

^or(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: At least one expression must be satisfied. Each entry in the value is a separate operand.

^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*(?:\\.[a-z0-9]+.description: Score level required for the topic
